description: BioMate QC threshold database — evidence-graded thresholds for bioinformatics QC gates
citation: BioMate QC Governance Framework (2026). bioRxiv. https://doi.org/10.1101/XXXXXX

governance_layers.RED_LINE: Absolute bounds enforced even when user overrides are active. Overrides that cross a red line are clamped to the bound and recorded in the audit log.
governance_layers.GOLD: Mandated by ENCODE4 or GATK Best Practices. Cannot be relaxed via qc_overrides. Changes require a platform-level code review with a new evidence citation.
governance_layers.SILVER: Strongly recommended by major consortia or peer-reviewed guidelines. Can be relaxed via qc_overrides.
governance_layers.BRONZE: Community practice or expert consensus without a single authoritative citation. Overridable; flagged as advisory when evidence is weak.
governance_layers.ADVISORY: Non-blocking informational gate. Workflow proceeds; metrics surfaced for operator awareness.

reads_surviving_pct.rationale: > 50% loss = adapter-dominated library; downstream analysis is invalid

fit_quality.rationale: CTF estimation completely failed; particle picking results are invalid

mito_fraction_pct.rationale: Dead-cell lysates, not transcriptomes; results are biologically meaningless

alignment_rate.evidence: ENCODE post-2020 standards; STAR/HISAT2 alignment to reference genome
alignment_rate.notes: Critical sub-threshold < 25% indicates species/genome mismatch (fixed, not overridable). Values 25-70% trigger warning.

reads_surviving_pct.evidence: FASTP / TrimGalore adapter trimming survival rate
reads_surviving_pct.notes: Red line at 50% (hard floor). Values below 70% suggest adapter-dominated or low-quality library.

q30_pct.evidence: Illumina Q30 base quality score threshold; standard NGS QC practice

assigned_reads_pct.notes: Fraction of reads assigned to annotated genomic features.

mapping_rate.evidence: Salmon / Kallisto quasi-mapping rate to transcriptome

cells_detected.evidence: 10x Genomics Cell Ranger v7 default; community practice
cells_detected.notes: Minimum viable cell count for downstream clustering analysis.

median_genes_per_cell.evidence: 10x Genomics Cell Ranger documentation; Luecken & Theis 2019 MSB
median_genes_per_cell.notes: Profile-adjustable: neuronal profile lowers to 300 (inhibitory interneurons).

mito_fraction_pct.evidence: Luecken & Theis 2019 Mol Syst Biol e8746; Osorio & Cai 2021 Bioinformatics PMC8599307
mito_fraction_pct.notes: Red line at 80%. Near-threshold warning at 10-20%. Cardiac profile raises to 40%; neuronal profile raises to 30%. Tissue-specific thresholds recommended (5% mouse, 10% human ideal).

tss_enrichment.evidence: ENCODE4 ATAC-seq 2022 standards: >= 7 high quality, >= 5 acceptable
tss_enrichment.notes: GOLD metric — cannot be overridden via qc_overrides. Values < 5.0 are failing; < 3.0 are critical. Near-threshold warning at 5.0-6.0.

frip_score.evidence: ENCODE4 ATAC-seq 2022: > 0.3 ideal, > 0.2 acceptable. EN-TEx tissue samples exempt.
frip_score.notes: Gate at 0.2 (acceptable floor). Ideal is >= 0.3 per ENCODE4.

nrf_score.notes: GOLD metric — cannot be overridden. NRF measures library complexity. < 0.5 is critical.

peaks_called.evidence: MACS2/3 peak calling; nf-core/chipseq pipeline defaults

frip_score.evidence: ENCODE4 ChIP-seq: no hard FRiP threshold defined. Historical 1% from Landt et al. 2012 ENCODE2/3 only.
frip_score.notes: ADVISORY only (non-blocking). ENCODE4 explicitly states FRiP is collected without defined thresholds.

duplicate_pct.evidence: GATK Best Practices (WGS <= 20-30%); domain-aware: skip for rna_seq, atac_seq, chip_seq, cut_and_run
duplicate_pct.notes: Skip domains: rna_seq, rnaseq, rna, scrna_seq, single_cell, atac_seq, atacseq, chip_seq, chipseq, cut_and_run, cutandrun, hic, hic_seq, hi_c

mean_coverage.evidence: GATK Best Practices — WGS >= 30X germline (Sims et al. 2014 Nature Rev Genet)
GATK Best Practices WES germline >= 80X; ACMG 2016 NGS Technical Standards
mean_coverage.notes: Applies to domains: wes, whole_exome, exome_seq, exome, targeted_seq, targeted. wes_research profile relaxes to 50X.

mapped_pct.evidence: GATK Best Practices — same as WGS

total_drift_angstrom.evidence: CryoSPARC v4 documentation; community practice (MotionCor2 default)
total_drift_angstrom.notes: Membrane protein profile raises to 80 Ang; in-situ cryo-ET profile raises to 150 Ang.

correlation_score.evidence: MotionCor2 cross-correlation score between frames; community practice

fit_quality.evidence: CTFFIND4 fit score threshold; CryoSPARC v4 default
fit_quality.notes: Red line at 0.5. Membrane protein profile relaxes to 0.65; phase plate profile relaxes to 0.65; in-situ cryo-ET relaxes to 0.5 (red line floor).

astigmatism_angstrom.evidence: CryoSPARC v4 documentation; community practice. No published consensus threshold.
astigmatism_angstrom.notes: ADVISORY (non-blocking). fit_quality is the primary CTF gate. High astigmatism may indicate lens contamination, coma, or specimen charging.

particles_picked.evidence: Community practice — minimum particle count for meaningful 2D classification

duplicate_fraction_picking.evidence: Particle picking NMS overlap threshold; community practice

junk_class_fraction.evidence: Community heuristic: < 50% good classes indicates poor particle quality or ice contamination
junk_class_fraction.notes: ADVISORY (non-blocking). Derived from num_good_classes / num_classes in class2d_report.json. > 0.70 is a separate higher-severity advisory.

fsc_resolution_angstrom.evidence: Henderson et al. 2012 gold-standard FSC 0.143 criterion; < 10 Ang required for drug discovery targets
fsc_resolution_angstrom.notes: Lower value = better resolution. Gate fires when resolution > 10 Ang (coarser than 10 Ang is not interpretable for drug discovery).

bfactor_angstrom_squared.evidence: Rosenthal & Henderson 2003 JMB 333:721; Terwilliger et al. 2018 Acta Cryst D74:545
bfactor_angstrom_squared.notes: ADVISORY (non-blocking). Expected range: -50 to -200 Ang^2. B > 0 = unusual blurring; B < -300 = over-sharpening.

local_resolution_std_spread.notes: Standard deviation of local resolution distribution. > 3 Ang indicates high conformational disorder.

avg_phase_shift_rad_min.evidence: Danev & Bharat 2018 Trends Cell Biol; CryoSPARC VPP tutorial 2023
avg_phase_shift_rad_min.notes: Volta Phase Plate gate. Applies only when phase plate data present (avg_phase_shift_rad metric). < 0.2 rad = VPP depleted.

avg_phase_shift_rad_max.evidence: Danev & Bharat 2018 Trends Cell Biol; CryoSPARC VPP tutorial 2023
avg_phase_shift_rad_max.notes: > 1.5 rad = VPP over-charged. Near-threshold warnings at 0.20-0.22 rad (approaching depletion) and 1.35-1.50 rad (approaching over-charge).

ramachandran_outliers_pct.evidence: MolProbity guidelines (Chen et al. 2010 Acta Cryst D66:12)

clashscore.evidence: MolProbity guidelines; < 20 expected for well-refined cryo-EM models

emringer_score.evidence: Barad BA et al. 2015 Nat Methods 12(10):943-946

classified_pct_critical.evidence: Wood, Lu & Langmead 2019 Genome Biology 20:257 (Kraken2); QIIME2 community standards
classified_pct_critical.notes: Profile-adjustable: human_gut raises to 50%, soil lowers to 3%, marine lowers to 4%, clinical_pathogen raises to 60%.

classified_pct_warning.evidence: Environmental metagenomics practice; novel environments 40-80% is normal
classified_pct_warning.notes: Warning tier (not critical). Profile-adjustable: soil lowers to 8%, marine lowers to 10%, clinical_pathogen raises to 70%.

psm_fdr_pct.evidence: Elias & Gygi 2007 Nature Methods (8000+ citations) — target-decoy FDR < 1%

protein_fdr_pct.evidence: Elias & Gygi 2007 Nature Methods — protein-level FDR < 1%

missed_cleavage_pct.notes: Phospho profile raises to 30% (phosphopeptides resist tryptic digestion).

cv_pct.evidence: EuBIC 2018 community standards; DIA community < 15% (Stenbratt et al. 2021)
cv_pct.notes: DDA default 20%; DIA-NN/Spectronaut default 15%. Plasma biomarker profile tightens to 15%; phospho profile relaxes to 25%.

phosphosite_localization_score.notes: Applies only when phosphosite localization data is present (phospho enrichment experiments).

psm_count.evidence: Community practice — minimum PSM count for standard cell lysate
psm_count.notes: ADVISORY (non-blocking). Pulldown/phospho experiments expected to have lower PSM counts. Pulldown profile lowers to 200; phospho profile lowers to 500.

missing_value_pct.evidence: Geyer et al. 2017 Cell Systems — plasma DIA proteomics standards
missing_value_pct.notes: Only enforced when plasma_biomarker profile is active.

median_enrichment_ratio.evidence: ABPP community practice — prey/input enrichment ratio > 3x
median_enrichment_ratio.notes: Chemoproteomics/pulldown experiments. < 3x = bead coupling failure or insufficient drug loading.

crapome_contamination_fraction.evidence: CRAPome database (crapome.org); Mellacheruvu et al. 2013 Nature Methods

herg_ic50_high_risk_uM.evidence: Sanguinetti & Tristani-Firouzi 2006 Nature 440:463; FDA E14 guidance 2005
herg_ic50_high_risk_uM.notes: hERG IC50 < 1 uM = high-risk QT prolongation / TdP risk. GOLD blocking.

herg_ic50_medium_risk_uM.evidence: Sanguinetti & Tristani-Firouzi 2006; ICH S7B cardiac safety guideline
herg_ic50_medium_risk_uM.notes: hERG IC50 1-10 uM = medium risk. SILVER advisory.

herg_inhibition_prob_threshold.evidence: ML model high-confidence threshold (when no experimental IC50 available)

dili_probability_threshold.evidence: Chen et al. 2016 Drug Metabolism and Disposition 44:1717; FDA DILIrank database
dili_probability_threshold.notes: dili_probability >= 0.8 = GOLD blocking; 0.7-0.8 = SILVER advisory. dili_risk='high' = GOLD blocking.

ames_probability_threshold.evidence: ICH S2(R1) guideline — Ames test required for all new drug substances before first-in-human dosing

clintox_probability_threshold.evidence: Wu et al. 2018 Mol Pharm 15:2362 — DeepPurpose ClinTox model

compound_mw_limit.evidence: Standard ADMET model applicability domain; drug-like space community practice
compound_mw_limit.notes: Profile-adjustable: compound_druglike lowers to 500 Da (Lipinski Ro5); compound_natural_product raises to 1000 Da.

auc_extrap_pct_max.evidence: FDA Guidance on PK studies 2018; Gabrielsson & Weiner 2006
auc_extrap_pct_max.notes: AUC extrapolated beyond last timepoint should be < 20% of AUCinf.

pgx_min_coverage.evidence: CPIC guidelines (cpicpgx.org) — 30x minimum for Tier 1 PGx genes
pgx_min_coverage.notes: Genes checked: CYP2D6, CYP2C19, CYP3A4, CYP3A5, CYP2C9, CYP1A2, DPYD, TPMT, NUDT15, SLCO1B1, UGT1A1, VKORC1. pgx_research profile lowers to 15x.

guide_library_coverage_pct.evidence: Replogle JM et al. 2022 Cell 185(14):2559-2575 (Perturb-seq genome-wide) Supp Methods
guide_library_coverage_pct.notes: Fraction of guide library represented in the cell pool. Low coverage reduces statistical power for hit calling.

transfection_efficiency_pct.evidence: Community practice from Perturb-seq and CROP-seq protocols
transfection_efficiency_pct.notes: ADVISORY (non-blocking). Acceptable for pilot screens. Low efficiency increases unperturbed cell fraction.

max_doublet_fraction_pct.evidence: Norman TM et al. 2019 Science 365(6455):786-793; Datlinger P et al. 2021 Nat Methods
max_doublet_fraction_pct.notes: ADVISORY (non-blocking). High doublet rate inflates guide co-occurrence and confounds perturbation effects.

rnaseq_polya_standard.description: Standard polyA-selected RNA-seq (default). No adjustments from platform defaults.
references: nf-core/rnaseq v3.14 defaults

rnaseq_ribodepleted.description: Total RNA with ribosomal depletion (RiboZero / RiboMinus). Lowered alignment rate and read survival thresholds to account for intronic read abundance.
references: Zhao S et al. 2020 RNA Biol 17(8):1105-1118

rnaseq_ffpe.description: FFPE-preserved tissue RNA-seq. RNA is highly fragmented, resulting in lower alignment rates, reduced Q30 scores, and more trimming failures.
references: Sinicropi D et al. 2012 PLoS ONE 7(5):e38396

rnaseq_single_nucleus.description: Single-nucleus RNA-seq (snRNA-seq). Intronic reads dominate; alignment to spliced mRNA reference is fundamentally lower.
references: 10x Genomics snRNA-seq Reagent Kit User Guide v2.0 (2023)

rnaseq_nonmodel_organism.description: Non-model organism RNA-seq with an incomplete or draft genome/annotation.
references: [BRONZE] community practice — no formal guideline

wgs_germline_standard.description: Standard germline WGS (default). 30X minimum coverage per GATK Best Practices.
references: GATK Best Practices — Germline SNP/Indel calling (2023)

wgs_germline_lowpass.description: Low-pass WGS (0.5-10X) for population genetics, imputation, and polygenic score studies.
references: Rubinacci S et al. 2021 Nat Genet 53:120-126 (UK Biobank)

wgs_somatic_tumor_only.description: Somatic tumor-only WGS without a matched normal. 80X for GATK Mutect2.
references: GATK Mutect2 Best Practices — Tumor-Only (2023)

wgs_ffpe.description: FFPE-derived WGS. High PCR bias substantially increases duplicate rates.
references: Robbe P et al. 2018 Nat Med 24:1555-1563

wes_research.description: Research-grade whole-exome sequencing. 50X for germline variant discovery.
references: nf-core/sarek v3 WES defaults

wes_clinical_germline.description: Clinical-grade WES for germline diagnostic reporting. 80X minimum per ACMG 2016.
references: ACMG/AMP 2016 Standards and Guidelines for NGS Diagnostics

scrna_standard.description: Standard single-cell RNA-seq (10x Genomics Chromium, default).
references: 10x Genomics Cell Ranger v7 defaults

scrna_cardiac.description: scRNA-seq from cardiac or skeletal muscle tissue. Cardiomyocytes are mitochondria-rich; 30-40% mito fraction is biologically expected.
references: Simonson B et al. 2023 Circ Res 132(9):1174-1193
Kuppe C et al. 2022 Nature 605(7909):319-326 (cardiac cell atlas)

scrna_neuronal.description: scRNA-seq from brain / neuronal tissue. Neurons have elevated mitochondrial content; 30% mito is appropriate.
references: [BRONZE] Allen Brain Atlas scRNA-seq QC guidelines (community practice)
Bakken TE et al. 2021 Nature 598:86-102 (Human Brain Cell Atlas)

scrna_perturbation.description: scRNA-seq with CRISPR perturbation (Perturb-seq, CROP-seq, CRISPRi screens). Adds guide library coverage, transfection efficiency, and doublet detection gates.
references: Replogle JM et al. 2022 Cell 185(14):2559-2575
Datlinger P et al. 2021 Nat Methods 18(6):688-693
Norman TM et al. 2019 Science 365(6455):786-793

metagenomics_human_gut.description: Human gut metagenomics with comprehensive database. 50% classification is the HMP empirical floor.
references: HMP Consortium 2012 Nature 486:207-214

metagenomics_soil.description: Soil metagenomics — high microbial dark matter fraction. Critical gate suppressed to 3%.
references: Bahram M et al. 2018 Nature 560(7717):233-237
Delgado-Baquerizo M et al. 2018 Science 359(6373):320-325

metagenomics_marine.description: Marine metagenomics — reference databases cover ocean microbiota poorly.
references: Sunagawa S et al. 2015 Science 348(6237):1261359 (TARA Oceans)

metagenomics_clinical_pathogen.description: Clinical metagenomics for pathogen detection (bloodstream infection, CSF). Very low classification warrants investigation.
references: [BRONZE] IDSA clinical metagenomics guidance (2024)

cryoem_spa_purified.description: Standard single-particle analysis of purified protein complexes (default).
references: EMPIAR deposition standards; EMDB validation report (2024)

cryoem_spa_membrane.description: SPA of membrane proteins (GPCRs, channels, transporters). Higher beam-induced motion; 80 Ang drift threshold.
references: [BRONZE] Membrane protein cryo-EM community practice (2024)

cryoem_spa_phase_plate.description: SPA with Volta Phase Plate (VPP). CTF fit quality thresholds relaxed; phase shift advisory gates activated.
references: [BRONZE] Danev & Bharat 2018 Trends Cell Biol — phase shift 0.4-0.8 pi rad optimal
[BRONZE] CryoSPARC VPP tutorial (2023)

cryoem_tomo_in_situ.description: Cryo-electron tomography of cellular lamellae prepared by FIB-SEM milling. High drift expected.
references: [BRONZE] FIB-SEM cryo-ET community practice; Bharat & Bharat 2024

proteomics_standard.description: Standard label-free DDA proteomics of cell lysate (default). GOLD PSM/protein FDR gate; SILVER missed cleavage/CV gates.
references: [GOLD] Elias & Gygi 2007, Nature Methods — PSM/protein FDR < 1%
[SILVER] EuBIC 2018 community standards — missed cleavage < 20%, CV < 20%

proteomics_phospho.description: Phosphopeptide enrichment proteomics (TiO2, IMAC, Fe-NTA). PSM count, missed cleavage, and CV gates relaxed.
references: [SILVER] Beausoleil et al. 2006, Nature Biotechnology — localization score > 0.75
[BRONZE] EuBIC 2018 phosphoproteomics community practice

proteomics_plasma_biomarker.description: Depleted plasma DIA/DDA proteomics for biomarker discovery. Tighter CV gate (< 15%); missing value fraction gate applied.
references: [SILVER] Geyer et al. 2017, Cell Systems — plasma DIA proteomics CV standards
[SILVER] EuBIC 2018 — depleted plasma QC community practice

proteomics_chemoproteomics.description: Affinity proteomics / chemoproteomics pulldown (ABPP, drug bead pulldown). Enrichment ratio gate is primary QC indicator.
references: [GOLD] Elias & Gygi 2007 — protein FDR < 1% (unchanged)
[SILVER] ABPP community practice — enrichment ratio > 3x input proteome

compound_druglike.description: Standard drug-like compound library QC applying Lipinski's Rule of Five (Ro5): MW <= 500 Da, logP <= 5, HBD <= 5, HBA <= 10.
references: [GOLD] Lipinski et al. (2001) Adv Drug Deliv Rev — Rule of Five
[SILVER] Veber et al. (2002) J Med Chem — oral bioavailability descriptors

compound_natural_product.description: Natural product and natural-product-inspired compound QC. Relaxed MW gate (<=1000 Da); no logP limit.
references: [SILVER] Newman & Cragg (2020) J Nat Prod — natural products in drug discovery
[BRONZE] Rodrigues et al. (2016) J Med Chem — NP-likeness beyond Ro5

compound_peptidomimetic.description: Peptidomimetic and stapled peptide compound QC. MW gate relaxed to <= 900 Da; higher HBD/HBA counts accepted.
references: [SILVER] Giordanetto & Kihlberg (2014) J Med Chem — beyond Ro5 for peptides
[BRONZE] Doak et al. (2016) J Med Chem — macrocycle oral bioavailability

pgx_clinical.description: Clinical pharmacogenomics (PGx) WGS QC — CPIC-compliant. Requires >= 30x coverage on each CPIC Tier 1 PGx gene.
references: [GOLD] CPIC guidelines (cpicpgx.org) — 30x minimum for tier 1 genes
[GOLD] GATK Best Practices — VQSR PASS rate > 95%
[SILVER] PharmVar — CYP2D6 copy number detection requirements

pgx_research.description: Research-grade pharmacogenomics WGS QC. Accepts >= 15x per-gene coverage with low-confidence calls flagged as advisory.
references: [SILVER] CPIC guidelines — 15x minimum for tier 2 research use
